resources.string: チャッド・ストリームズ
Sign in with your Xtream account
Your provider gave you a server address, a username and a password. Enter them here, or paste the whole M3U link into the server field and Chud Supreme will read the rest from it.
Press the centre button on a field to open the keyboard.
Signed in. Loading your channels, films and series. Large lists can take a few minutes.
Signed in. Loading your channels, films and series: %1$,d so far. Large lists can take a few minutes.
All set. Your channels are in Home and Library.
Enter the server address from your provider.
Enter both your username and password.
Couldn\'t reach that server. Check the address, including the port number, then try again.
Couldn\'t find a server called %1$s. Check the spelling, and that the Fire TV is online.
%1$s isn\'t accepting connections on that port. Check the port number (often 8080 or 80).
%1$s didn\'t answer in time. Check the port number, or try again in a moment.
Couldn\'t make a secure connection to %1$s. Try the address with http:// instead of https://.
%1$s refused the connection (error 403). Your provider may be blocking this device, app or network; check with them.
%1$s answered with error %2$d. Check the address, or try again later.
%1$s answered, but not with Xtream account data. Use the base address your provider gave you, like http://example.com:8080.
The server didn\'t accept that username and password.
This account is marked \"%1$s\". Contact your provider to renew it.
This account isn\'t active. Contact your provider to renew it.
Signed in, but loading channels failed. Check your connection and try again.
Xtream logins and M3U playlists on this device
Server sent a web page, not account data
Rewind skips back %1$d seconds, fast-forward skips ahead %2$d
The provider didn\'t send details for this title.
The provider hasn\'t listed any episodes for this series.
Add a live TV playlist to see the guide.
Schedules come from Xtream accounts, and this channel isn\'t from one.
Choose a channel to see its schedule.
Programmes marked Catch up can be replayed from the start.
Up and down move between channels, left and right move through time. Press OK to watch.
Token name, symbol or contract address
Couldn\'t reach DEX Screener. Trying again in 30 seconds.
The last update failed, so these prices may be out of date. Trying again in 30 seconds.
Nothing to show for this chain right now.
Your watchlist is empty. Press OK on any token to add it.
Search for a token by name, symbol or contract address, then press Done.
Updated %1$s. Data from DEX Screener, refreshed every 30 seconds.
Move through the list to see a token\'s details. Press OK to add it to your watchlist or remove it.
Five games for the remote. Back returns here.
Game over\nScore %1$d\nPress OK to play again
Steer, eat, grow. Don\'t hit the walls or yourself.
Fit the falling pieces together to clear full rows.
Level %1$d. Left and right move, up turns, down drops faster, OK drops at once
Bounce from ledge to ledge and climb as high as you can.
Hold left or right to steer. Off one side, back on the other
One deck. The dealer stands on 17. You start with 100.
European wheel. Red, black, even or odd.
Signed in, but the server took too long to send its channel list. Try again, ideally when it\'s less busy.
Signed in, but the connection dropped while loading channels. Check the Fire TV\'s internet and try again.
Signed in, but the Fire TV is out of storage space for the channel list. Free some space and try again.
Signed in, but this account has more than a million channels, films and series, which is more than Chud Supreme can hold.
Enter the playlist link your provider gave you. It usually ends in .m3u or .m3u8. Add a guide (XMLTV) link as well if you have one, to fill the TV guide.
Loading the playlist. Large lists can take a few minutes.
Loading the playlist: %1$,d channels so far. Large lists can take a few minutes.
Playlist added. Its channels are in Home and Library.
M3U playlist with a TV guide
Enter the playlist link, starting with http:// or https://.
Couldn\'t load that playlist. Check the link opens in a browser, then try again.
No video player app is installed for this. Install VLC from the Amazon Appstore, or pick the built-in player in Settings.
VLC isn\'t installed, so this plays in the built-in player. Get VLC from the Amazon Appstore.
Knows your channels, films and series · %1$s
Ask for something to watch, what\'s on right now, or where to find a show. Claude looks through your own library and can start it for you.
Use your own Anthropic API key to chat with Claude about what to watch. Keys start with sk-ant- and come from console.anthropic.com. Chats are charged to your Anthropic account.
The key is stored encrypted on this Fire TV and only ever sent to Anthropic. Tip: the Amazon Fire TV app on your phone has a keyboard you can paste the key into.
Claude is looking through your library…
e.g. a funny film under two hours
Pick me a film for tonight
Add your Anthropic API key first.
Anthropic didn\'t accept that API key. Check it and try again.
Your Anthropic account is out of credit. Add some at console.anthropic.com.
Too many requests at once. Wait a moment and try again.
Claude is busy right now. Try again in a moment.
Couldn\'t reach Anthropic. Check the Fire TV\'s internet connection.
Something went wrong talking to Claude (%1$s). Try again.
Stream stopped. Press OK to try again.
Press Back again to close Chud Supreme
Press Back twice to close the app
On when the TV lists 120 Hz
Pass through to TV or soundbar
API key from opensubtitles.com (Profile, API consumers)

Delay rows: press Left or Right to adjust, OK to reset. Picture, sound and buffer changes apply from the next stream. For HDR to switch on and off with each show, set Fire TV Settings, Display and Sounds, Display, Dynamic Range Settings to Adaptive.
Left or Right to adjust, OK to reset
No subtitles found for this title
Add your OpenSubtitles API key in Settings, Playback.
OpenSubtitles didn\'t accept the API key.
Today\'s OpenSubtitles download limit is used up. Try again tomorrow.
OpenSubtitles had a problem. Try again later.
Your own keys for extra features. Type them here or send them from the phone page. They stay encrypted on this Fire TV and only go to their own service.
API key (v3) or read access token from themoviedb.org
Client ID of an app you create at trakt.tv/oauth/applications. Redirect URI can be urn:ietf:wg:oauth:2.0:oob.
The secret from that same Trakt app. Infinity uses it for the device code, then syncs your watchlist, up next and scrobbles.
Paste a key from sportsgameodds.com. Live prices turn on for the leagues that key covers. ESPN fractions stay on either way.
Token of your own bot, from @BotFather
Your chat ID with that bot (numbers)
The Telegram bot you trade with, e.g. @yourbot
Fine-grained token with Issues: read and write on that repository
The last ten channels, films and episodes you played
Hold OK on a channel to add it to a group of your own
No favourite channels yet. Hold OK on a channel and choose Add to favourites.
This group is empty. Hold OK on a channel and choose Favourite groups.
Films and series you saved, and what you\'re partway through
Nothing saved yet. Hold OK on a film or series and choose Save to My Library.
Tell me about \"%1$s\" (from %2$s): what it is, why people like it, and similar things in my playlists.
From TMDB. Marked ones are in your playlists.
QR code for the IMDb page
Add a Trakt client ID in Settings, Services to see reviews and comments here.
Contains spoilers. Press OK to read.
Add your Telegram bot token and chat ID in Settings, Services first.
Telegram didn\'t take it. Check the bot token and chat ID.
Add the repository and token first
GitHub refused. Check the token and repository.
Send reports when the app starts
QR code for the phone page
Scan with a phone on the same Wi-Fi, or open:
Add favourites or open a category in Live TV first.
You stay signed in. Live TV, films and series appear as soon as the list finishes downloading.
HDR, HDR10+ and Dolby Vision on
Sign in to an Xtream account, or add an M3U playlist, in Accounts. Xtream accounts bring live TV, films and series.
Press OK on the box to type. Searches live TV, films and series.
Install Cinemeta or TMDB for posters, then Torrentio or AIOStreams for links. Real-Debrid and TorBox play cached torrents. P2P streams on this Fire TV when those aren\'t set.
One press installs a known addon. AIOStreams needs the manifest URL from your own config.
On. TorrServe is used when it answers, otherwise this Fire TV streams from peers.
Off. Streams need a direct link or a debrid account.
Live channels, films and series, by category.
OK picks a skin. Any change below makes your own copy of it; hold OK on your own skins to delete them.
Changes are saved to “%1$s”. Hold OK on it above to delete it.
Accent as hex (press OK to type)
Background as hex (press OK to type)
Skins are small text files. Paste one on the phone page (Settings > Services), import one from a link, or save the current one to share it from the phone page.
That link didn’t give a skin file.
Saved. Open the phone page to download it.
OK shows or hides a button. Left and Right move it along the row.
Put the buttons back in their usual order
Everyone on the same Wi‑Fi: one box starts a party from the player and reads out its code, the others type it here and play along in step.
Others on your Wi‑Fi join with the code
Couldn’t start a party. Check the Wi‑Fi connection.
Not in your playlists; playing the host’s stream instead.
No party found on this network
The host isn’t playing anything yet
Add the client ID and secret above first
Sign in to Trakt in Settings › Services to rate, comment and keep your history.
Left/Right to pick, OK to save
Trakt wants at least five words.
Trakt didn’t accept that. Check the sign-in in Settings.
From your Trakt account · OK opens it in your playlists
IMDb, Rotten Tomatoes, Metacritic and Letterboxd scores on details pages. Free at mdblist.com › Preferences › API.
IMDb, Rotten Tomatoes and Metacritic scores (used when there is no MDBList key). Free at omdbapi.com.
Extra logos and clear art. Free at fanart.tv › API.
Nothing saved yet. Open a title and choose Library.
Up next fills in after you save a series, or when Trakt has something paused.
Nothing on the calendar. Save a series, or sign in to Trakt.
OK hides or shows a row. Left and Right move it. Rename gives it your own name.
Put every row back as it was
Sign in to your Jellyfin or Emby server on the home network. Films and series play straight from it, and what you watch is kept in step with the server.
Couldn’t reach the server. Check the address and that it’s on the same network.
The server didn’t accept that user name and password.
The server answered with an error. Try again.
No app on this TV can open YouTube links.
From the last day on your favourite channels · OK replays it

Profiles decide what each person can reach. A kids profile keeps to live TV, films, series, the guide and favourites, hides adult categories, and can stop after a set time. A PIN keeps a profile to its owner.
New PIN (4–8 digits), OK to save
Playback has stopped for this profile. A grown-up can pick another profile.
A backup holds every setting, your skins and your favourites. Keep one on this stick, or download it from the phone page and paste it back on another Fire TV.
Save a backup on this stick
Restore the backup kept on this stick
Restored %1$d settings, %2$d skins and %3$d favourites. Some settings take effect after a restart.
Restored %1$d settings and %2$d favourites from the phone.
The backup didn’t work. Try again.
Town (leave empty to use the network’s location)

This is a kids profile. A grown-up can switch profiles from here; everything else is in their profile.
Profile settings are kept behind a grown-up’s PIN.

Night mode and the dialogue boost shape the sound on the stick. With Dolby or DTS sent straight to a soundbar, use the soundbar\'s own night mode instead.
Hold Menu anywhere to open these. Hold Back to leave the player completely.

The lights dim while a film or channel plays full screen and come back up when it stops. Philips Hue pairs with a press of the bridge\'s button; Home Assistant runs your own scenes or scripts.
No Hue bridge found on this network.
Press the round button on the Hue bridge, then OK on Find and pair within 30 seconds.

Films and shows on a NAS or a computer at home. Add a shared folder (SMB) or a WebDAV address; the files play right here, with seeking.
Hold OK on a share to forget it.
That shared folder isn\'t on this TV any more.
The computer or NAS address and the shared folder\'s name. Leave the user empty for guest access.
